Lets Portland-area cities require affordable units in new multiunit housing only if they pay the developer an offset worth at least the expected loss in value. Under housing_affordability the whole dispute — whether an inclusionary requirement produces affordable homes or suppresses building — sits inside the area, and the Act does both things at once: it authorizes the requirement and constrains it. A reader cannot be told honestly what a yes vote was for. The AZ SB 1611 precedent: where the trade is the dispute itself, drop.
